name: Nightmare Jack
original_name: ナイトメア・ジャック
source: After sacrificing himself in order to save [url=/c68684]Little Mermaid[/url] and almost dying, Jack's body got covered in vines, which transformed him into his current state. Despite his current appearance and his intelligence dropping down an infant's level, he still retains his kindness, which helps him support the Chishiki Girls during battles.
translation: After sacrificing himself in order to save [url=/c68684]Little Mermaid[/url] and almost dying, Jack's body got covered in vines, which transformed him into his current state. Despite his current appearance and his intelligence dropping down an infant's level, he still retains his kindness, which helps him support the Chishiki Girls during battles.
